requirements.why_needed: من دونه قد تُفهم الأعمدة على أنها مؤشرات أخرى أو على أنها تغطي جميع الاقتصادات، لا الاقتصادات المختارة فقط.

evidence.text: شكل 3: عدد الصناعات سويا في اقتصادات مختارة في منطقة شمال أفريقيا والشرق الأوسط

requirements.interpretation_note: كلمة «سويا» ظاهرة بهذه الصيغة في العنوان، ولا يُفترض تصحيحها أو تفسيرها.

requirements.description: المحور الرأسي يعرض مقياسًا عدديًا يبدأ من 0 ويصل إلى 9000، مع تدريجات ظاهرة بفواصل 1000.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: يوفر أساس قراءة ارتفاع كل عمود وقيمته العددية.
requirements.why_needed: حفظ القيم المطبوعة وحدها لا يكفي لفهم وحدة القياس أو نطاق الرسم ومقارنة ارتفاعات الأعمدة.

evidence.location: أعلى تدريج ظاهر على المحور الرأسي
تدريج ظاهر قرب أعلى المحور الرأسي
التدريج عند خط الأساس أسفل المحور الرأسي

requirements.interpretation_note: التدريجات الوسيطة ظاهرة بصريًا على المحور؛ لم تُستخدم لحساب قيم غير مطبوعة.

requirements.description: لكل عمود تسمية اقتصادية على المحور الأفقي، وتشمل تسميات منفردة وأخرى متعددة الكلمات.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: تحدد الكيان الذي تنسب إليه قيمة عدد الصناعات.
requirements.why_needed: بدون ربط كل تسمية بعمودها لا يمكن إعادة استخدام القيم أو إجراء مقارنة بين الاقتصادات.

evidence.location: التسمية متعددة الأسطر أسفل العمود السادس

requirements.interpretation_note: التسميات معروضة باتجاه عمودي/مدوّر، ولذلك يلزم الحفاظ على حدود كل تسمية متعددة الأسطر.

requirements.candidate_name: قيمة عدد الصناعات المطبوعة فوق العمود
requirements.description: يعرض الشكل قيمة عددية فوق كل عمود، مع أعمدة صغيرة جدًا وأخرى مرتفعة بدرجة كبيرة.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: تمثل النتيجة العددية المنسوبة إلى الاقتصاد المقابل.
requirements.why_needed: هذه القيم هي النتائج التحليلية الأساسية؛ فقدانها أو فصلها عن الاقتصاد المقابل يزيل محتوى المقارنة.
requirements.interpretation_note: القائمة تحفظ النصوص الرقمية كما تظهر؛ لا تُستنتج دقة إضافية من ارتفاعات الأعمدة.

requirements.description: الأعمدة مرتبة أفقيًا، وكل قيمة مطبوعة فوق عمودها والتسمية المقابلة أسفله. الترتيب الظاهر يبدأ من الجزائر وينتهي بإيران، مع ازدياد عام في ارتفاع الأعمدة من اليسار إلى اليمين.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: يحافظ على إسناد كل قيمة إلى الاقتصاد الصحيح وعلى ترتيب العرض الأصلي.
requirements.why_needed: إذا حُفظت القيم أو التسميات دون المواضع والاقتران بينهما فقد تُنسب قيمة إلى اقتصاد آخر.
requirements.interpretation_note: الاقتران بين القيمة والتسمية مستند إلى المحاذاة البصرية للعمود، وليس إلى وجود صياغة نصية تجمعهما.

requirements.description: يورد الشكل مصدر البيانات وسنة المصدر في أسفل الصورة.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: يوفر سياق منشأ البيانات والزمن المرتبط بالمصدر المذكور.
requirements.why_needed: قد تختلف أعداد الصناعات باختلاف المصدر أو السنة؛ حذف هذا السياق يضعف قابلية تفسير المقارنة وإعادة استخدامها.

relationships.interpretation_note: العلاقة مستدل عليها من المحاذاة المكانية في الرسم.

ambiguities.implication_for_representation: يجب الحفاظ على حدود كل تسمية وترتيب كلماتها عند تمثيل العلاقة مع العمود.

ambiguities.description: يظهر أسفل الرسم النص «الأوسط» بوضوح، بينما لا يظهر في الموضع نفسه نص أفقي كامل يشرح تسمية المحور؛ والعنوان وحده يذكر «شمال أفريقيا والشرق الأوسط».
ambiguities.location: أسفل الجهة اليمنى من منطقة الرسم

analytical_units.description: Prices and government finance data for Guinea, combining a year-column table with an inflation line chart.
analytical_units.location: Upper portion of image, from “PRICES and GOVERNMENT FINANCE” through the first chart.

requirements.description: The data are identified with Guinea.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Provides the geographic context for all values in this unit.
requirements.why_needed: Without the country context, the figures cannot be reliably attributed or reused.

requirements.description: The table uses the years 1982, 1992, 2001, and 2002 as reference columns.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Associates each tabular result with a specific year.
requirements.why_needed: Values without their year cannot be interpreted as a time series or compared correctly.

evidence.location: Prices and government finance table header
Prices and government finance table header
Prices and government finance table header
Prices and government finance table header

requirements.description: Domestic price results are expressed as percentage changes and include separate consumer-price and implicit-GDP-deflator rows.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Defines the measure and distinguishes the two reported price series.
requirements.why_needed: The same numeric value would have different meaning depending on whether it refers to consumer prices or the GDP deflator and whether it is a percentage change.

requirements.description: Government-finance results are expressed as percentages of GDP and explicitly include current grants.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Supplies the denominator and qualification for the government-finance rows.
requirements.why_needed: The figures cannot be reused correctly as government-finance amounts without the stated GDP basis and grants qualification.

requirements.description: The table uses “..” in cells where no numeric result is printed.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Distinguishes unavailable or unreported cells from numeric zeroes.
requirements.why_needed: Replacing these marks with zero or silently omitting them would change the meaning and completeness of the data.

evidence.location: 1982 cells in the domestic-prices and government-finance rows; also visible in other year cells

requirements.interpretation_note: The image does not define the exact meaning of the marker.

requirements.description: A line chart titled “Inflation (%)” shows two visually distinct series, GDP deflator and CPI, over the labeled years 96 through 02; one series uses diamond markers and the other a dotted line.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Represents a second time presentation of inflation results and preserves the distinction between the two series.
requirements.why_needed: The chart contains analytical observations and trends not recoverable from the table alone; the series identity, percent scale, and year positions are needed to interpret its plotted values.
requirements.interpretation_note: Exact plotted values are not printed, so no numeric chart observations are recorded.

analytical_units.description: Trade data presented as a year-column table and an export/import bar chart.
analytical_units.location: Middle portion of image, from “TRADE” through the second chart.

requirements.description: The trade table reports selected results for 1982, 1992, 2001, and 2002.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Provides the temporal reference for trade rows.
requirements.why_needed: Trade values require a year to be comparable and reusable.

requirements.description: Most trade amounts are stated in US$ millions.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Defines the scale and currency of export and import amounts.
requirements.why_needed: The numbers are not interpretable as trade amounts without their unit and currency.
requirements.interpretation_note: The row qualifiers “fob” and “cif” are retained as source wording; their expansion is not supplied by the image.

requirements.description: Exports and imports are broken into named component rows, including other metals, aluminum, manufactures, food, fuel and energy, and capital goods.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Identifies the category dimension of the trade results.
requirements.why_needed: Component values cannot be interpreted or compared without their category labels and whether they belong to exports or imports.

requirements.description: Three trade indices use 1995 as the base year equal to 100.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Defines the reference base for export prices, import prices, and terms of trade.
requirements.why_needed: Index values are not reusable without the stated base and the identity of the index series.

requirements.description: A grouped bar chart titled “Export and import levels (US$ mill.)” shows separate Export and Imports bars for years 96 through 02, with a vertical numeric scale.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Preserves the chart’s visual comparison between export and import levels over time.
requirements.why_needed: The chart supplies a visual time series and comparison structure, even though exact bar values are not printed.
requirements.interpretation_note: Exact values represented by the bars are not printed.

requirements.description: The trade table uses “..” for cells without a displayed numeric result.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Preserves the distinction between an absent/unreported result and a zero.
requirements.why_needed: Converting the marker to zero would alter trade totals or component values.

evidence.location: Visible in 1982 and 2002 trade-table cells and in the manufactures row

requirements.interpretation_note: The image does not explain the marker.

analytical_units.description: Balance of payments data with a year-column table, a current-account chart, and a memo subsection.
analytical_units.location: Lower-middle portion of image, from “BALANCE of PAYMENTS” through the current-account chart and memo rows.

requirements.description: The table uses 1982, 1992, 2001, and 2002 columns.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Provides time references for balance-of-payments results.
requirements.why_needed: The balance figures require a time reference for interpretation.

requirements.description: The principal balance-of-payments rows are stated in US$ millions.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Defines the currency and scale for flows, balances, and financing items.
requirements.why_needed: The numeric results cannot be interpreted without their amount unit.

requirements.description: The table distinguishes exports, imports, resource balance, net income, net current transfers, current account balance, financing items, and changes in net reserves.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Preserves the component and subtotal structure of the balance-of-payments presentation.
requirements.why_needed: Flattening the rows would lose distinctions among component flows, balances, and financing entries.

requirements.description: A bar chart titled “Current account balance to GDP (%)” displays negative bars for years 96 through 02 on a percentage scale extending from 0 to -10.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Represents the current-account result as a GDP ratio and preserves its year-by-year visual pattern.
requirements.why_needed: The chart uses a ratio presentation distinct from the table’s US$ million presentation.
requirements.interpretation_note: Exact chart values are not printed.

requirements.description: A memo subsection reports reserves including gold in US$ millions and a conversion rate in DEC, local/US$.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Keeps supplementary monetary-context measures separate from the principal balance-of-payments rows.
requirements.why_needed: These memo measures have different meanings and units from the balance rows and should not be merged with them.

requirements.description: The table uses 1982, 1992, 2001, and 2002 columns.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Provides temporal references for debt and resource-flow results.
requirements.why_needed: Debt and flow figures require their reporting year.

requirements.description: Debt and resource-flow table amounts are stated in US$ millions.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Defines the scale and currency of the debt and flow figures.
requirements.why_needed: The figures cannot be compared or reused correctly without their unit.

evidence.location: Immediately below “EXTERNAL DEBT and RESOURCE FLOWS”

requirements.description: Debt outstanding and debt service are broken down by IBRD and IDA.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Preserves the lender-specific distinctions under the total debt measures.

evidence.location: Indented rows beneath total debt outstanding and disbursed and total debt service
Indented rows beneath total debt outstanding and disbursed and total debt service

requirements.description: Composition of net resource flows is reported for official grants, official creditors, private creditors, foreign direct investment, and portfolio equity.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Defines the category dimension for resource flows.
requirements.why_needed: The meaning of each flow depends on its financing category.

requirements.description: World Bank program results are divided into commitments, disbursements, and principal repayments.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Preserves the distinction among program flow types.
requirements.why_needed: These are different stages or types of financing activity and cannot be treated as interchangeable amounts.

requirements.description: A pie chart titled “Composition of 2001 debt (US$ mill.)” represents labeled lender/source categories with abbreviated labels and amounts: A through G.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Preserves the composition and category-to-amount mapping for the 2001 debt total.

requirements.description: The external-debt table uses “..” in cells without a displayed numeric result, especially in the 2002 column.
requirements.function_in_this_unit: Preserves missing or unreported debt and flow entries rather than treating them as zero.
requirements.why_needed: The absence of a displayed value must not be mistaken for no debt or no flow.
